summary: Sheriff's deputies booked a 20-year-old man on a charge of street robbery with a gun and a 34-year-old man on charges of sexual abuse of a child on Thursday. The jail roster showed 34 criminal bookings dated Nov. 5 and one so far on Nov. 6.

entries.title: Armed robbery arrest: Jamichael Jermaine Deangelo Wheat
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Jamichael Jermaine Deangelo Wheat, 20, at 2:29 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read early Friday.

He was booked on a charge the jail lists as street robbery with a gun — taking property by force or threat in a public place, with a firearm. The sheriff's office had not posted a release about the arrest when its page was checked.

entries.title: Child sex abuse arrest: Terry Lamar Veal
body: Terry Lamar Veal, 34, was booked into the county jail on Thursday, Nov. 5, on a sheriff's office arrest, according to the jail roster. The roster gives the arrest time as 12:45 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4. He was in custody when the roster was read early Friday.
He was booked on charges of sexual abuse of a child under 12 and sodomy by force, as the roster lists them. No further details have been released.

entries.title: Aggravated assault arrest: Robert H Ryan
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Robert H Ryan, 44, at 12:02 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read early Friday.
He was booked on charges of aggravated assault on a family member with a gun — a serious assault on a household member involving a firearm — and indecent exposure or a lewd act in public.

entries.title: Aggravated assault arrest: Micheal Ray Jackson
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Micheal Ray Jackson, 56, at 11:06 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, according to the jail roster. The roster shows him released Friday, Nov. 6.
He was booked on a charge of aggravated assault with a weapon other than a gun or knife, against someone outside his family, as the roster lists it.

entries.title: Family-violence arrests: five booked Nov. 5
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Scott Edward Yates, 40, at 3:47 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, on charges of simple assault on a family member, burglary of a non-residential building without force, and public intoxication, according to the jail roster. Deputies arrested Jamyron Jawuan Anderson, 23, at 6:43 a.m. on a charge of third-degree domestic violence (criminal mischief) — damaging property of a household member. Both were released the same day.

Deputies also arrested Bernard Robert Guenther, 47, at 10:17 a.m.; James Van Heuvel Corte, 57, at 11:45 a.m.; and Michelle Leann Pomier, 38, at noon, each on a charge of harassment of a family member — threatening, striking or alarming a household member. All three were in custody when the roster was read early Friday.

entries.title: Drug arrests: Haleigh Savanna Keenon, Tamala Marie Frye
body: Robertsdale police arrested Haleigh Savanna Keenon, 31, at 11:15 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, on charges of possession of a controlled substance, second-degree marijuana possession, drug paraphernalia and tampering with physical evidence, according to the jail roster.

Sheriff's deputies arrested Tamala Marie Frye, 58, at 4:22 p.m. Thursday on two counts of possession of a controlled substance and a charge of drug paraphernalia. Both were in custody when the roster was read early Friday.

entries.title: Stolen-property arrest: Amanda Kristen Connell
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Amanda Kristen Connell, 41, at 7:16 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, on charges of selling stolen property and buying or receiving stolen property, according to the jail roster. The roster shows her released Friday, Nov. 6.
The roster also lists a Nov. 3 booking under the same name and age on a theft charge, from which she was released the same day.

entries.title: Protection-order arrest: Darris O'Neil Grace
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Darris O'Neil Grace, 30, at 8:20 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday morning.
He was booked on a charge of violating a domestic-violence protection order — disobeying a court order to stay away from or not contact a protected person.

entries.title: Drug arrests: Charlie Oniel Crook, Micah Peyton Clark
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Charlie Oniel Crook, 38, on Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of possession of a controlled substance with intent to distribute, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

Fairhope police arrested Micah Peyton Clark, 28, at 11:57 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, at Section Street and Gayfer Avenue; the city's arrest log lists unlawful possession of a controlled substance (THC oil). He was booked into the county jail Wednesday on a charge of possession of dangerous drugs and was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Drunk-driving arrest: Savannah Aaliyah Fretwell
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Savannah Aaliyah Fretwell, 23, at 6:15 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol, according to the jail roster. The roster shows her released Thursday, Nov. 5.

entries.title: Sex offender registration arrest: Marcus Ezekiel McKillion
body: Marcus Ezekiel McKillion, 28, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 1:02 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on a charge listed as SORNA — a violation of Alabama's sex offender registration and notification law. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

entries.title: Indecent exposure arrest: Raymond Alexander Madison
body: Raymond Alexander Madison, 33, was booked into the county jail by sheriff's deputies on Wednesday, Nov. 4, according to the jail roster. The roster gives an arrest date of Aug. 21 at 3:24 a.m.
He was booked on charges of disorderly conduct (disturbing the peace) and indecent exposure — exposing oneself in a way likely to offend. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

entries.title: Bay Minette arrests: Laquila Nashay Andrews, Shauna Michelle Whitley
body: Bay Minette police arrested Laquila Nashay Andrews, 35, at 3:09 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of theft of lost property — keeping property known to be lost without trying to return it, according to the jail roster. She was released the same day.
Police arrested Shauna Michelle Whitley, 40, at 11:37 a.m. Wednesday on two counts of failure to appear, comply or pay. The roster shows her released.

entries.title: Fugitive arrest: John Alexander Michael Burns
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested John Alexander Michael Burns, 37, at 12:30 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of being a fugitive from justice — held on a warrant from another state, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.
